lines.raw: Generic dispensing rate (GDR).

lines.raw: GDR equals Generic fills ÷ All fills.
lines.say: G D R equals Generic fills ÷ All fills.

lines.raw: For example: Emily: 6 generic fills ÷ 6 fills equals 100%.
lines.say: For example: Emily: 6 generic fills ÷ 6 fills equals 100 percent.

lines.raw: If one atorvastatin fill had been brand Lipitor instead, it would be 5 ÷ 6 equals 83.3%.

lines.raw: Plans track GDR across all members; a high GDR usually means lower costs.
